hanzi: すみません、タクシー乗り場はどこですか。
pinyin: sumimasen, takushī noriba wa doko desu ka
gloss: Excuse me, where is the taxi stand?
situation: Looking for taxis outside a station or airport

hanzi: タクシーを一台お願いします。
situation: Asking hotel staff to call you a taxi

hanzi: この住所までお願いします。
situation: Showing the driver an address on your phone

hanzi: 東京駅までお願いします。
situation: Telling the driver your destination

hanzi: ここに行きたいんですけど。
pinyin: koko ni ikitai n desu kedo
situation: Pointing at a map or screen for the driver

hanzi: だいたいいくらかかりますか。
gloss: About how much will it cost?
situation: Checking the fare before you get in

hanzi: 何分ぐらいかかりますか。
gloss: About how many minutes will it take?
situation: Asking the driver how long the ride is

hanzi: 急いでもらえますか。
situation: You're running late for a flight or train

hanzi: 次の信号で止めてください。
pinyin: tsugi no shingō de tomete kudasai
gloss: Please stop at the next light.
situation: Telling the driver where to pull over

hanzi: ここで大丈夫です。
situation: Stopping the taxi at your spot

hanzi: カードで払えますか。
situation: Checking payment options in the taxi

hanzi: 現金でお願いします。
situation: Telling the driver how you'll pay

hanzi: スイカ、使えますか。
situation: Asking if your IC card works here

hanzi: 領収書をください。
situation: After paying the taxi driver

hanzi: 荷物、トランクに入れてもいいですか。
pinyin: nimotsu, toranku ni irete mo ii desu ka
gloss: Can I put my bags in the trunk?
situation: Loading luggage into the taxi

hanzi: 切符はどこで買えますか。
pinyin: kippu wa doko de kaemasu ka
gloss: Where can I buy a ticket?
situation: Finding the ticket machines in a station

hanzi: 大阪まで大人二枚ください。
gloss: Two adult tickets to Osaka, please.
situation: Buying tickets at the counter

hanzi: 何番線ですか。
situation: Asking staff where your train leaves from

hanzi: この電車、渋谷に行きますか。
pinyin: kono densha, shibuya ni ikimasu ka
gloss: Does this train go to Shibuya?
situation: Checking before you board

hanzi: どこで乗り換えますか。
situation: Asking about a connection on your route

hanzi: 何線に乗ればいいですか。
pinyin: nanisen ni noreba ii desu ka
situation: Confused by the subway map

hanzi: 終電は何時ですか。
gloss: What time is the last train?
situation: Planning your night out

hanzi: 空港行きのバスはどこですか。
pinyin: kūkō yuki no basu wa doko desu ka
gloss: Where's the bus to the airport?
situation: Finding the right bus stop

hanzi: このスーツケース、持ち込めますか。
gloss: Can I bring this suitcase on board?
situation: Asking staff about luggage on a train or bus
